node.title: Re^3: Complex file manipulation challenge
node.author: Tux
node.doctext:
I did not read the original problem statement :)

csv (in => $fh, out => undef, on_in => sub { ... }); supports streaming and does not store in memory (other than the current record. Rewriting my version to do that can be an exercise to the reader.

In preparation I found that [metamod://PerlIO::via::gzip] *only* supports open my $fh, ":via(gzip)", "file.gz"; and *not* open my $fh, ">", "file.gz"; binmode $fh, ":via(gzip)"; :( :(


Enjoy, Have FUN! H.Merijn
